figures.claim: The tibial footprint sits in the posterior intercondylar fossa and runs down the posterior cortex for roughly 1 cm below the joint line.
Describe the femoral footprint as a crescent whose anterior border lies within about 3 mm of the cartilage edge.
Conventional teaching gives the fossa a width of about 13 mm.
A 70 degree arthroscope is used to see the posterior tibia from within the joint, because the angle of the notch hides the lower part of the footprint from a 30 degree view.
